business_problem: A leading international agribusiness company began its digital transformation by implementing a new enterprise management system with Microsoft Azure.
solution_summary: SLC Agrícola, a Financial Services organization in Brazil, modernized this data lake / data warehouse modernization workload with Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, and Microsoft 365 E5. A leading international agribusiness company began its digital transformation by implementing a new enterprise management system with Microsoft Azure. Azure Kubernetes Service runs the containerized services and data-processing workloads that need elastic compute at scale. Azure Databricks processes, engineers, and analyzes data workloads on scalable Spark infrastructure. Azure Synapse Analytics unifies analytical processing, data engineering, and reporting workloads on a shared platform. Data from SAP is ingested into Azure Kubernetes Service, processed across Azure Databricks, and surfaced through Azure Synapse Analytics so teams can act on fresher operational insight.
